titleEn: Widest Vertical Area Between Two Points Containing No Points
title: 两点之间不包含任何点的最宽垂直区域
summary: 给定平面点集，找两条竖线之间不含任何点的最大宽度，点的纵坐标不影响答案。
insight: 只提取并排序所有横坐标。任意空白竖直带的边界必是排序后相邻的两个横坐标，取最大差即可。
pitfalls: 区域内部不含点，边界可经过点
相同横坐标产生宽度零

solutions.title: 横坐标排序相邻差
solutions.idea: 把二维问题降为一维最大间隔。
steps: 按点的 x 坐标排序
从第二个点开始计算相邻 x 差

code.java: class Solution { public int maxWidthOfVerticalArea(int[][] points){Arrays.sort(points,Comparator.comparingInt(point->point[0]));int answer=0;for(int i=1;i<points.length;i++)answer=Math.max(answer,points[i][0]-points[i-1][0]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxWidthOfVerticalArea(points:Array<IntArray>):Int{val x=points.map{it[0]}.sorted();var answer=0;for(i in 1 until x.size)answer=maxOf(answer,x[i]-x[i-1]);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxWidthOfVerticalArea(vector<vector<int>>& points){sort(points.begin(),points.end());int answer=0;for(int i=1;i<(int)points.size();++i)answer=max(answer,points[i][0]-points[i-1][0]);return answer;} };
